note: Only captured_sha256 came across untouched. Step 2 (the ViT) was not brought across: it has no official-style variant in the capture. The checkpoint directory in the captured config was an absolute path on the cluster and is not shipped.

rewritten_during_the_port.__init__.py: empty in the capture; kept empty
rewritten_during_the_port.models/__init__.py: advertised the step 2 ViT through a lazy __getattr__. The module was not brought across, so the package was promising a name it could not import.
rewritten_during_the_port.data/__init__.py: re-exported the step 2 loader, which was not brought across
rewritten_during_the_port.train_step1_resnet.py: resolve_device() and make_deterministic() added, and the unconditional .cuda(local_rank) on the model and on each crop replaced by .to(device); the captured trainer could not start without a GPU. main() split into build_parser() and run(args, config), which returns the epoch loss and the epoch count; the captured version computed them and discarded them.
rewritten_during_the_port.data/multi_crop.py: captured sha256 c-- taken before the change. get_swav_dataloader built a DistributedSampler unconditionally, which needs an initialised process group, so this method could not run on one process at all -- on a GPU or otherwise. The sampler is now conditional, the same way every other ported method's loader already had it, and the trainer passes its own `distributed` flag through. Unlike the change the port before this one made and reverted, this one is for a failure that was observed: the run raised 'Default process group has not been initialized'.
